wrong_order.text: 灯控台：顺序不符，请核对节目单。
系统：彩排临时改过场次顺序，纸质节目单早就过时了。得看现场的痕迹。

reversal_before.text: 系统：别高兴得太早，把纸条翻过来看看背面。

reversal_after.text: 玩家：我抢票进来，抓了个替身？
系统：背面印着剧社的道具编号。这是张舞台替身，真家伙早就趁乱溜出剧场了。

wake_narration.speaker: narrator
wake_narration.voiceTextEn: You do not have five minutes. Still, the confidence is impressive.
wake_narration.subtitleZh: 早八快上课了。不得不说，你还敢赖床，心理素质真硬。

xy_attack.speaker: system
xy_attack.voiceTextEn: Wait, wait, wait. You are trying to skip class? Absolutely not. I am not letting you check in.
xy_attack.subtitleZh: 等等——人还在被窝里就想隔空签到？想得美！这分我今天扣定了！

xy_laugh.speaker: system
xy_laugh.voiceTextEn: Go find your digits. All four of them. Ha.
xy_laugh.subtitleZh: 签到码给你拆碎咯，慢慢找去吧哈哈哈！

sys_balance.speaker: system
sys_balance.subtitleZh: 校园卡余额：0.06元。这点钱连起床气都买不起。

sys_net_try.speaker: system
sys_net_try.subtitleZh: ZJUWLAN 正在疯狂转圈。它尽力了，你也尽力了。

tiyi_47.speaker: system
tiyi_47.subtitleZh: 体艺打卡：47/48次。离满分永远只差最后一次，经典的绝望。

gear_pickup.speaker: system
gear_pickup.subtitleZh: 哟，从设置图标上抠下来一个生锈的齿轮？

act1_locked_entry.speaker: system
act1_locked_entry.subtitleZh: 游戏开了。想接管角色，先给自己办个手续。

act1_identity_verified.speaker: system
act1_identity_verified.subtitleZh: 身份核验通过。角色有名字了，网还没连上。

act1_phone_linked.speaker: system
act1_phone_linked.subtitleZh: 电话通了。用十位学号给自己打电话，也就校园内网想得出来。

act1_controls_installed.speaker: system
act1_controls_installed.subtitleZh: 手柄到了。浙大体艺还没批你走路。

act1_movement_enabled.speaker: system
act1_movement_enabled.subtitleZh: 锻炼记上了。恭喜，你的腿现在可以用了。

act1_required_item_collected.speaker: system
act1_required_item_collected.subtitleZh: 卡带拿到了。继续把地图走完，四个区域一个都不能漏。

act1_map_completed.speaker: system
act1_map_completed.subtitleZh: 全图已刷。游戏菜单已开放，系统已记录你会走路。

prologue_narrator_intro.speaker: narrator
prologue_narrator_intro.voiceTextEn: Pfft, oh, sorry. I did not mean anything by it. It is just... this does not look like a success, does it? I suppose you will have to get up, drag yourself to class, and deal with it. Good luck, kid! I am leaving!
prologue_narrator_intro.subtitleZh: 噗……抱歉，没忍住。这弹窗看着像是签到成功了吗？同学，还是起床去教室吧。祝你好运，我先走了！

prologue_narrator_caught.speaker: narrator
prologue_narrator_caught.voiceTextEn: Hey! What exactly do you think you are doing? Let go of me!
prologue_narrator_caught.subtitleZh: 喂，你拿报错框卡我干什么？快松手！

prologue_narrator_bargain.speaker: narrator
prologue_narrator_bargain.voiceTextEn: Oh, fine, fine! But first, take your hand off me!
prologue_narrator_bargain.subtitleZh: 行行行，我帮你。先把锁定松开！

act2_system_found_intro.speaker: system
act2_system_found_intro.voiceTextEn: Oh, damn it. You win, kid.

act2_system_inventory_missing.speaker: system
act2_system_inventory_missing.voiceTextEn: Wait. Where is your inventory? You cannot expect me to work empty-handed!
act2_system_inventory_missing.subtitleZh: 等等，你连道具栏都丢了？你指望我空着手给你改记录？

act2_system_just_find_it.speaker: system
act2_system_just_find_it.subtitleZh: 回寝室把校园卡和道具栏找回来。

act2_system_departure.speaker: system
act2_system_departure.voiceTextEn: You found it. Great. Then let us get moving.
act2_system_departure.subtitleZh: 总算找着了。行，那赶紧操作你床上的身体出门吧！

act2_system_confession.speaker: system
act2_system_confession.voiceTextEn: I should be honest. I do not have permission to edit attendance records.
act2_system_confession.subtitleZh: 先说清楚，我没权限改考勤记录。

act2_system_friend.speaker: system
act2_system_friend.voiceTextEn: But I have a friend who might.
act2_system_friend.subtitleZh: 基础馆有个老朋友，她也许有办法。

act2_system_library.speaker: system
act2_system_library.voiceTextEn: If we still want your participation grade, we need to find her in the library.
act2_system_library.subtitleZh: 还想要平时分的话，就去图书馆找她。

act2_system_move_now.speaker: system
act2_system_move_now.subtitleZh: 听明白了？那就赶紧动身。

act2_character_cannot_hear.speaker: system
act2_character_cannot_hear.subtitleZh: 别戳他了，他听不见。没绑定姓名和学号之前，他就是个没加载完的默认建模。

act2_character_named.speaker: system
act2_character_named.subtitleZh: 姓名和学号一致。很好，他现在知道自己是谁了。

act2_push_triangle_collected.speaker: system
act2_push_triangle_collected.subtitleZh: 拆下来一个播放键三角。再去天气页接滴雨水试试？

act2_weather_water_collected.speaker: system
act2_weather_water_collected.subtitleZh: 雨水到手。去看看导师头像旁边那根卡死的竖线，泡软了应该能抠下来。

act2_mentor_line_stuck.speaker: system
act2_mentor_line_stuck.subtitleZh: 这根分割线焊得死死的。毕竟是导师的对话框，连排版都透着一股压迫感。

act2_right_arrow_assembled.speaker: system
act2_right_arrow_assembled.subtitleZh: 三角加横杆，拼成右移箭头了。去看看你的余额小数点能不能往右挪挪？

act2_balance_shifted.speaker: system
act2_balance_shifted.subtitleZh: 小数点往右挪了两位。六分钱，变六块了。

act2_gamepad_purchase_rejected.speaker: system
act2_gamepad_purchase_rejected.subtitleZh: 卡里就剩六分钱，卖家不接一百期。

act2_exit_ready.speaker: system
act2_exit_ready.subtitleZh: 走吧，去基础图书馆一楼，找 022 号座位！

library_story_library_entered_02.speaker: system
library_story_library_entered_02.subtitleZh: 在入馆闸机最后的登记记录里。她一直待在一层书库。

library_story_library_entered_03.speaker: player
library_story_library_entered_03.subtitleZh: 她是这里的图书管理员？

library_story_library_entered_04.speaker: system
library_story_library_entered_04.subtitleZh: 不是。她不管借书，也不在教职工名册里。

library_story_library_entered_05.speaker: player
library_story_library_entered_05.subtitleZh: 那是谁？总不能是馆长吧。

library_story_library_entered_08.speaker: system
library_story_library_entered_08.subtitleZh: 是一层书库的 022 号座位。

library_story_library_entered_09.speaker: player
library_story_library_entered_09.subtitleZh: ……你是说，你的朋友是一张桌子？

library_story_library_entered_10.speaker: system
library_story_library_entered_10.subtitleZh: 准确地说，是绑定在 022 号座位上的旧版选座终端。上次系统升级前，全校的考勤与选座时间戳都归她管。

library_story_library_entered_12.speaker: system
library_story_library_entered_12.subtitleZh: 先刷卡进馆。入馆记录在手机图书馆的座位预约里，点「我的」就能查。

library_story_library_gate_record_checke.speaker: narrator
library_story_library_gate_record_checke.subtitleZh: 手机屏幕显示：08:02 刷卡入馆，一层书库 022 会话未闭合。

library_story_library_gate_record_checke.speaker: system
library_story_library_gate_record_checke.subtitleZh: 入馆记录确认了。进馆去一层书库 022，对照桌牌找到座位。

library_story_library_occupied_seat_foun.speaker: narrator
library_story_library_occupied_seat_foun.subtitleZh: 022 座位被一个书包占着，旁边压着一张占座纸条。

library_story_library_occupied_seat_foun.speaker: player
library_story_library_occupied_seat_foun.subtitleZh: 明明预约了 022，位置却被书包占了。

library_story_library_occupied_seat_foun.speaker: system
library_story_library_occupied_seat_foun.subtitleZh: 先别直接挪动它。拿起旁边的占座纸条看看上面写了什么。

library_story_library_occupation_note_pi.speaker: narrator
library_story_library_occupation_note_pi.subtitleZh: 占座纸条上写着：“主人马上回来（临时离座规则详见 CC98）”，落款时间停在 08:02。

library_story_library_occupation_note_pi.speaker: player
library_story_library_occupation_note_pi.subtitleZh: 离座规则还要去论坛上查？

library_story_library_occupation_note_pi.speaker: system
library_story_library_occupation_note_pi.subtitleZh: 打开手机里的 CC98，用纸条上的关键词搜出 022 的调查帖。

library_story_cc98_occupation_post_opene.speaker: system
library_story_cc98_occupation_post_opene.subtitleZh: 翻看帖子里提到的旧规书名，确认怎么处理超时占座。

library_story_cc98_occupation_post_opene.speaker: player
library_story_cc98_occupation_post_opene.subtitleZh: 12 楼提到一本《三分钟离座法及其例外》。

library_story_cc98_occupation_post_opene.speaker: system
library_story_cc98_occupation_post_opene.subtitleZh: 把书名记进任务记录。去馆内的馆藏检索终端查这本书的架位。

library_story_library_catalog_match_foun.speaker: narrator
library_story_library_catalog_match_foun.subtitleZh: 检索结果匹配：《三分钟离座法及其例外》，基础馆一层 · 06架南端上层，索书号 755。

library_story_library_catalog_match_foun.speaker: system
library_story_library_catalog_match_foun.subtitleZh: 架位已经记下了。去基础馆一层 06 架南端上层，抽出索书号 755 的旧版离座规则。

library_story_library_archived_rule_reco.speaker: player
library_story_library_archived_rule_reco.subtitleZh: 看你这语气，流程很阴间？

library_story_library_archived_rule_reco.speaker: system
library_story_library_archived_rule_reco.subtitleZh: 它要求集齐三类申请证明，还要连同本册规则一起发到 CC98 完成四项公开公示。

library_story_library_archived_rule_reco.speaker: system
library_story_library_archived_rule_reco.subtitleZh: 规则只认材料：022 座位小票、本人来过证明、书包非本人证明。

library_story_library_archived_rule_reco.speaker: system
library_story_library_archived_rule_reco.subtitleZh: 三条取证线已经记入任务记录。先回 022 桌面夹缝和书包现场取证，或去前台和体艺处理。

library_story_library_front_desk_proof_r.speaker: player
library_story_library_front_desk_proof_r.subtitleZh: 我要给 022 的占座书包办一张《书包非本人证明》。

library_story_library_front_desk_proof_r.speaker: system
library_story_library_front_desk_proof_r.subtitleZh: 系统里它目前登记为座位使用者。请先回 022 给书包拍照，与相册里的旧照完成核对，再把生成的核验报告交来前台盖章。

library_story_library_front_desk_proof_r.speaker: system
library_story_library_front_desk_proof_r.subtitleZh: 注意把相机显示亮度调到 20 以下，否则书包标签过曝无法识别。

library_story_library_bag_nonperson_proo.speaker: system
library_story_library_bag_nonperson_proo.subtitleZh: 核验报告确认无误，已加盖非本人证明章。

library_story_library_bag_nonperson_proo.speaker: system
library_story_library_bag_nonperson_proo.subtitleZh: 《书包非本人证明》拿到了。打开任务记录查看还缺哪项材料；若三份证明已齐，就回 CC98 调查帖上传公示。

library_story_library_bag_nonperson_proo.speaker: player
library_story_library_bag_nonperson_proo.subtitleZh: 我今天跑的证明比上课还多。

library_story_library_crevice_inspected_.speaker: narrator
library_story_library_crevice_inspected_.subtitleZh: 022 桌面夹缝深处卡着一张座位小票，徒手伸不进去。

library_story_library_crevice_inspected_.speaker: system
library_story_library_crevice_inspected_.subtitleZh: 直接拿够不到。找找身边或桌面上有没有细长硬实的物件，把 022 座位小票拨出来。

library_story_library_seat_receipt_recov.speaker: narrator
library_story_library_seat_receipt_recov.subtitleZh: 小票从桌面夹缝里滑了出来，上面印着：基础馆一层 022。

library_story_library_seat_receipt_recov.speaker: system
library_story_library_seat_receipt_recov.subtitleZh: 《022 座位小票》拿到了。可查看任务记录继续补齐剩余证明，集齐后回 CC98 调查帖公示。

library_story_tiyi_presence_proof_issued.speaker: system
library_story_tiyi_presence_proof_issued.subtitleZh: 补录审核通过。出发到入馆用时已关联至 47 号公示记录。

library_story_tiyi_presence_proof_issued.speaker: player
library_story_tiyi_presence_proof_issued.subtitleZh: 终于有一项证明的是我自己。

library_story_tiyi_presence_proof_issued.speaker: system
library_story_tiyi_presence_proof_issued.subtitleZh: 到馆记录已归档。按任务记录核对剩余缺项；若三项证明均已备齐，即可回 CC98 调查帖上传公示。

library_story_cc98_evidence_set_complete.speaker: player
library_story_cc98_evidence_set_complete.subtitleZh: 四项公开材料都传上去了，现在能申请恢复座位了吧？

library_story_cc98_evidence_set_complete.speaker: system
library_story_cc98_evidence_set_complete.subtitleZh: 还差公开确认。看置顶说明：按上传栏从上到下的顺序，给每项材料找一条对应的数字回复点 bd，拼出四位热度口令。

library_story_cc98_evidence_set_complete.speaker: player
library_story_cc98_evidence_set_complete.subtitleZh: 还要我去发帖控评？那个“bd”又是什么？

library_story_cc98_evidence_set_complete.speaker: system
library_story_cc98_evidence_set_complete.subtitleZh: bd 是“帮顶”。每点一次数字回复上的 bd，对应数字就会按顺序写入热度口令。

library_story_cc98_top_ten_reached_01.speaker: narrator
library_story_cc98_top_ten_reached_01.subtitleZh: 调查帖冲上十大第一，四项公开材料公示生效。

library_story_cc98_top_ten_reached_02.speaker: system
library_story_cc98_top_ten_reached_02.subtitleZh: 公示完成了。打开手机里的「图书馆服务 → 022 恢复申请」，提交三份申请证明领取解除占座 PASS。

library_story_library_seat_release_pass_.speaker: system
library_story_library_seat_release_pass_.subtitleZh: 《解除占座 PASS》已发放。带它回一层书库 022，把解除占座 PASS 用在书包上。

library_story_library_seat_release_pass_.speaker: player
library_story_library_seat_release_pass_.subtitleZh: 这次终于能把 022 收回来了。

library_story_library_backpack_evicted_0.speaker: system
library_story_library_backpack_evicted_0.subtitleZh: 解除占座 PASS 核验通过，请占座物品离开 022。

library_story_library_backpack_evicted_0.speaker: system
library_story_library_backpack_evicted_0.subtitleZh: 如需认领，请前往失物招领处。

library_story_library_backpack_evicted_0.speaker: system
library_story_library_backpack_evicted_0.subtitleZh: 占座纸条上的这句话已经留了三天。现在 022 空出来了，坐下吧。

library_story_library_friend_contacted_0.speaker: seat022
library_story_library_friend_contacted_0.subtitleZh: 你终于把那个书包清走了。

library_story_library_friend_contacted_0.speaker: player
library_story_library_friend_contacted_0.subtitleZh: 你就是系统说的那位老朋友？……一个座位？

library_story_library_friend_contacted_0.speaker: system
library_story_library_friend_contacted_0.subtitleZh: 她以前管考勤归档，现在常驻 022。

library_story_library_friend_contacted_0.speaker: seat022
library_story_library_friend_contacted_0.subtitleZh: 你以前也没缩在浙大钉的红圈里。

library_story_library_friend_contacted_0.speaker: system
library_story_library_friend_contacted_0.subtitleZh: 叙旧等会儿。先查查这位同学早八的签到还能不能补。

library_story_library_friend_contacted_0.speaker: seat022
library_story_library_friend_contacted_0.subtitleZh: 奇怪，今天 07:55 的签到记录不在原来的页面里。

library_story_library_friend_contacted_0.speaker: seat022
library_story_library_friend_contacted_0.subtitleZh: 它夹在一张写着“本人马上回来”的纸条里，时间还卡在 07:55。

library_story_library_friend_contacted_1.speaker: player
library_story_library_friend_contacted_1.subtitleZh: 夹在纸条里？那纸条往哪跑了？

library_story_library_friend_contacted_1.speaker: seat022
library_story_library_friend_contacted_1.subtitleZh: 现在看不见。它钻进 07:55 留下的残影里了。

library_story_library_friend_contacted_1.speaker: seat022
library_story_library_friend_contacted_1.subtitleZh: 深色能看见它留下的痕迹。要动现场的东西，再切回浅色。

library_story_library_friend_contacted_1.speaker: player
library_story_library_friend_contacted_1.subtitleZh: 刚才门边是不是闪了一下？

library_story_library_friend_contacted_1.speaker: system
library_story_library_friend_contacted_1.subtitleZh: 跟上它，往东区食堂那边！

library_story_library_friend_contacted_2.speaker: system
library_story_library_friend_contacted_2.subtitleZh: 那不是它在说话，是原主人三天前留下的语音残影！快追！

c3_canteen_queue_system.speaker: system
c3_canteen_queue_system.voiceTextEn: Maybe it only came to experience the queue. Many things end up queuing in a cafeteria.
c3_canteen_queue_system.subtitleZh: 系统：连一张逃跑的签到纸进了东区食堂都得排队。

c3_canteen_labor_system.speaker: system
c3_canteen_labor_system.voiceTextEn: Because you need money, and they need labor.
c3_canteen_labor_system.subtitleZh: 系统：你没零钱，收餐口正好缺人收盘子。

c3_canteen_bun_system.speaker: system
c3_canteen_bun_system.voiceTextEn: That does not look like something a paper slip would eat. Admittedly, paper should not eat at all.
c3_canteen_bun_system.subtitleZh: 系统：这玩意儿喝一口就醒了。摆到宣传板上，没准能把队伍劝退。

c3_canteen_breakfast_system.speaker: system
c3_canteen_breakfast_system.voiceTextEn: No. It is merely a disappointingly real breakfast.
c3_canteen_breakfast_system.subtitleZh: 系统：想多了，就是个肉包，没夹纸。

c3_canteen_paper_chicken_system.speaker: system
c3_canteen_paper_chicken_system.voiceTextEn: Paper-wrapped chicken. At least the first word is suspicious.
c3_canteen_paper_chicken_system.subtitleZh: 系统：纸包鸡。光看前两个字就很可疑。

c3_canteen_packaging_system.speaker: system
c3_canteen_packaging_system.voiceTextEn: One clue. The chicken is only packaging.
c3_canteen_packaging_system.subtitleZh: 系统：先看包着鸡的那张纸。

c3_canteen_cold_clue_system.speaker: system
c3_canteen_cold_clue_system.voiceTextEn: The congee is hot. The clue is cold.
c3_canteen_cold_clue_system.subtitleZh: 系统：粥是烫的。纸条没往一号窗口钻。

c3_canteen_worldview_system.speaker: system
c3_canteen_worldview_system.voiceTextEn: Please do not expand the worldbuilding.
c3_canteen_worldview_system.subtitleZh: 系统：打住。换个窗口验票。

c3_canteen_paper_impact_narrator.speaker: narrator
c3_canteen_paper_impact_narrator.voiceTextEn: The paper crashes back into the cafeteria and sheds a flicker of blue light.
c3_canteen_paper_impact_narrator.subtitleZh: 纸条撞回食堂，抖落了一地蓝色的数据残影。

c3_canteen_paper_angry_narrator.speaker: narrator
c3_canteen_paper_angry_narrator.voiceTextEn: The paper is getting desperate. It has stopped respecting the pickup procedure.
c3_canteen_paper_angry_narrator.subtitleZh: 纸条从窗口弹出来，绕开队伍，直奔食堂大门。

c3_canteen_self_service_system.speaker: system
c3_canteen_self_service_system.voiceTextEn: Self-service has advanced too far. I am mildly concerned.
c3_canteen_self_service_system.subtitleZh: 系统：餐盘车还能堵门。后勤看见得给你发张奖状。

c3_bike_escape_narrator.speaker: narrator
c3_bike_escape_narrator.voiceTextEn: The paper flees along the main road.

c3_bike_human_speed_system.speaker: system
c3_bike_human_speed_system.voiceTextEn: You are moving at the speed of a human who skipped breakfast.
c3_bike_human_speed_system.subtitleZh: 系统：你这速度追不上。路边有辆共享单车。

c3_bike_gpa_system.speaker: system
c3_bike_gpa_system.subtitleZh: 系统：人家没有绩点负担，飞得当然比你快。

c3_bike_no_money_system.speaker: system
c3_bike_no_money_system.voiceTextEn: That sentence occurs far too often in this game.
c3_bike_no_money_system.subtitleZh: 系统：“余额不足”这四个字，今天真是刻进你DNA里了。先去帮阿姨收盘子赚钱吧。

c3_theater_failure_narrator.speaker: narrator
c3_theater_failure_narrator.subtitleZh: 旁白：摔得挺干脆。车没坏，起来还能追。

c3_theater_logic_system.speaker: system
c3_theater_logic_system.voiceTextEn: They changed the running order. The printed program may be out of date.
c3_theater_logic_system.subtitleZh: 系统：彩排临时改过场次顺序，纸质节目单早就过时了。得看现场的痕迹。

c3_theater_celebrate_system.speaker: system
c3_theater_celebrate_system.subtitleZh: 系统：别高兴得太早，把纸条翻过来看看背面。

c3_theater_substitute_system.speaker: system
c3_theater_substitute_system.voiceTextEn: The substitute has a serial number. The program says nothing about where the original went.
c3_theater_substitute_system.subtitleZh: 系统：背面印着剧社的道具编号。这是张舞台替身，真家伙早就趁乱溜出剧场了。

c3_qizhen_no_trail_system.speaker: system
c3_qizhen_no_trail_system.voiceTextEn: No idea. This time it left no paper scraps along the road.
c3_qizhen_no_trail_system.subtitleZh: 系统：跟丢了。这次它学精了，沿路半点蓝光都没漏。

c3_qizhen_forum_system.speaker: system
c3_qizhen_forum_system.voiceTextEn: Use the old method. Ask the campus forum.
c3_qizhen_forum_system.subtitleZh: 系统：遇事不决上 98。发个悬赏帖，让全校的夜猫子帮你找。

c3_qizhen_cc98_system.speaker: system
c3_qizhen_cc98_system.voiceTextEn: CC98 has provided a highly precise range: not the restroom.
c3_qizhen_cc98_system.subtitleZh: 系统：98 那几个目击帖说的是靠桥的水边。再找一条能对上的记录。

c3_qizhen_catalog_system.speaker: system
c3_qizhen_catalog_system.voiceTextEn: It means the paper is currently more artistic than we are.
c3_qizhen_catalog_system.subtitleZh: 系统：馆藏写着只在水面倒影里出现。它还真挑地方。

c3_qizhen_map_system.speaker: system
c3_qizhen_map_system.voiceTextEn: Congratulations. You have completed a campus-scale guessing game.
c3_qizhen_map_system.subtitleZh: 系统：三条线索拼齐——目标锁定，启真湖！

c3_qizhen_reflection_system.speaker: system
c3_qizhen_reflection_system.voiceTextEn: More precisely, it is inside the reflection.
c3_qizhen_reflection_system.subtitleZh: 系统：它没泡在水里，是卡在湖面的倒影图层里了。

c3_qizhen_swimming_system.speaker: system
c3_qizhen_swimming_system.voiceTextEn: For someone who cannot swim, the difference is substantial.
c3_qizhen_swimming_system.subtitleZh: 系统：别想不开往水里跳，你体艺游泳课还没修呢。找船过去。

c3_qizhen_gone_system.speaker: system
c3_qizhen_gone_system.subtitleZh: 系统：水波一晃，它又缩回深色倒影里了。

c3_qizhen_sign_system.speaker: system
c3_qizhen_sign_system.voiceTextEn: Should there not be a sign around here to point us somewhere?
c3_qizhen_sign_system.subtitleZh: 系统：岸边那块旧指示牌木头不错，拆下来正好当右船桨使。

c3_qizhen_hiding_system.speaker: system
c3_qizhen_hiding_system.voiceTextEn: So this is where it is hiding. Hah.
c3_qizhen_hiding_system.subtitleZh: 系统：锁定坐标了！它就猫在这片倒影底下。

c3_qizhen_display_system.speaker: system
c3_qizhen_display_system.voiceTextEn: Hang it somewhere public. Let everyone see it.
c3_qizhen_display_system.subtitleZh: 系统：把它挂到哪里去，让大家看看！

c3_qizhen_fake_system.speaker: system
c3_qizhen_fake_system.subtitleZh: 系统：把刚才在剧场抓到的那张假替身挂在鱼钩上！

c3_qizhen_ego_system.speaker: system
c3_qizhen_ego_system.voiceTextEn: Because it cannot tolerate someone else escaping in its place.
c3_qizhen_ego_system.subtitleZh: 系统：一个占了三天座位的老赖，绝对容不下冒牌货顶替它的位置。

c3_qizhen_atmosphere_system.speaker: system
c3_qizhen_atmosphere_system.voiceTextEn: You have only made the lake more atmospheric.
c3_qizhen_atmosphere_system.subtitleZh: 系统：偏了！你这杆甩下去，除了惊起两圈水波啥也没钓着。

c3_qizhen_taunt_system.speaker: system
c3_qizhen_taunt_system.voiceTextEn: It is still mocking your reflection.
c3_qizhen_taunt_system.subtitleZh: 系统：瞧见没，水底下的正主正隔着倒影看你笑话呢。对准点！

c3_qizhen_release_narrator.speaker: narrator
c3_qizhen_release_narrator.voiceTextEn: The paper springs out of the lake reflection and skims along the ground.
c3_qizhen_release_narrator.subtitleZh: 纸条从湖面倒影弹出来，贴着地面飞。

c3_qizhen_now_system.speaker: system
c3_qizhen_now_system.voiceTextEn: Now! It is back in the light layer!
c3_qizhen_now_system.subtitleZh: 系统：现在！它回到浅色模式了！

ch4_prologue_narrator_01.speaker: narrator
ch4_prologue_narrator_01.voiceTextEn: The lake did not keep it. The night wind carried it into the teaching building that was still lit.
ch4_prologue_narrator_01.subtitleZh: 湖水没有留住它。晚风裹着那张纸条，一路吹进了还亮着灯的段永平教学楼。

ch4_prologue_cleaner_01.speaker: cleaner
ch4_prologue_cleaner_01.voiceTextEn: Careful, I just mopped. That paper went inside.
ch4_prologue_cleaner_01.subtitleZh: 哎同学当心脚下，刚拖的地！你追的那张纸片往大厅里头飞了。

ch4_prologue_guard_01.speaker: guard
ch4_prologue_guard_01.voiceTextEn: The North Teaching Building is closing. Please pack up.
ch4_prologue_guard_01.subtitleZh: 同学，北教马上二十三点清楼了啊，拿完东西赶紧出来！
